name: Awka

requests.outcome: 200 HTML. Official Ministry page states ANAMGIS is a digital geospatial data repository for Certificate of Occupancy processing, geospatial analysis, land acquisition/allocation, and land administration. No map viewer URL, service URL, schema, CRS, parcel ID, or geometry response exposed.

200 HTML. Official Ministry report confirms ANAMGIS was commissioned at the Ministry of Lands headquarters in Awka and describes digital mapping/land-administration objectives. No anonymous parcel endpoint or geometry exposed.

Search result exposed official land/property procedure content; direct curl returned HTTP 403 during this attempt. The indexed official content describes the Land Use Office in Awka, cadastral vetting, title numbers, survey plans, and land-registration procedures, but not a public parcel API. No bypass attempted.

HTTP 403 Cloudflare managed challenge (cf-mitigated: challenge). The official Ministry page links this host for online land services. No CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, login, credentials, or private token was attempted. No JavaScript/configuration or parcel response could be inspected.
Official national Surveyor-General site identified in discovery; general surveying/cadastral-service prose only. No Awka-specific parcel endpoint or geometry requested.

schemaCrs.details: No public parcel response was obtained; native field schema, CRS, geometry encoding, and stable parcel identity could not be verified.

scopeLimits: ANAMGIS and Ministry of Lands evidence establish the local custodian and a state GIS/land-administration system, not public parcel coverage or an admissible runtime adapter.
Online services were blocked by a Cloudflare challenge; this is an access limitation, not evidence of parcel absence.
No exact-point query was issued because no public parcel endpoint was discovered and the only online-service route was challenge-protected.
No map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI is treated as citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, transaction, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native ID plus full parcel polygon was verified.
uncertainty: High: Anambra's official ANAMGIS system may contain Awka parcel data behind its protected online services or an internal/public route not exposed in the inspected pages. Independent serial review is required before adapter or source admission.
